topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: The rain's been coming down in sheets, like it’s trying to wash the city clean. I got a call from a painter, someone who uses brushes instead of brass knuckles. His work, he says, has found its way onto skin. Not the way he imagined it, not on canvas. This was a kind of exposure he didn’t ask for. Some punk took his art and made it permanent. Cheap thrills, maybe, or a statement, who knows. Thing is, this city’s full of people looking for a way to leave their mark. Problem is, when you’re dealing with ink and flesh, there’s no erasing it. I told him I’d see what I could dig up, but in this town, the line between admirer and vandal gets pretty damn blurry.
